messages.author: d12379035be5c6f9
messages.subject: pkde() error
parts:
Hi Chris,

I am trying to run pkde for four individuals and I am getting the error pasted below. Any guess what could be happening here? This is vhf data so the sampling frequency is very irregular.

The code I am using and the data is attached. Thanks. All the best,

Adrian

FITS <- list()
for(i in 1:length(absent))
{
  GUESS <- ctmm.guess(absent[[i]],CTMM=ctmm(error=TRUE),interactive=FALSE)
  FITS[[i]] <- ctmm.fit(absent[[i]],GUESS,trace=2)
}

UDabsent <- akde(absent,FITS,weights=TRUE,trace=TRUE)

PKDEabsent <- pkde(absent,UDabsent) 
Fitting location-mean model Dirac-δ(μ)
Fitting location-mean model isotropic-μ
Fitting location-mean model anisotropic-μ
* Model selection for location-mean μ distribution.
                ΔAICc
Dirac-δ(μ)    0.00000
isotropic-μ   5.25765
anisotropic-μ     Inf
Fitting covariance model E[major,tau position,tau velocity] VAR[]
Error in if (any(!ZERO)) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: pkde() error
parts:
Hi Adrian,

You need to use ctmm.select() instead of ctmm.fit() here. I have the error fixed for the next update, but you don't want to be feeding models with unsupported parameters into mean() or pkde(), which is what triggered this error.

Best,
Chris

Thanks for the help.

I ran it again using the latest release from GitHub. It did not work using ctmm.select(), but it worked when using ctmm.fit(). I got results and was able to export the UD using ctmm.fit().
